passive.name: Living Vengeance
passive.resolvedDescription: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

Q.name: Piercing Arrow
Q.resolvedDescription: Begin Charging: Varus draws back his next shot, Slowing himself by 20%. After 4 seconds, if not fired, Varus will cancel the Ability and refund 50% of its Mana cost. Release: Varus releases the arrow, dealing {{ totaldamagemin }} physical damage, reduced by 15% per enemy hit (minimum 33%). Damage and Blight detonation effects are increased by up to 70% based on charge time (up to to {{ totaldamagemax }} physical damage.

W.name: Blighted Quiver
W.resolvedDescription: Passive: Varus' Attacks deal an additional 4/10/16/22/28 (+30% AP) (+20% bonus AD) magic damage and apply a Blight stack for 6 seconds (max 3 stacks). Varus' other Abilities detonate Blight stacks dealing {{ percenthpperstack }} max Health magic damage per stack (max {{ maxpercenthpperstack }} max Health damage). Detonating Blight on champions and epic monsters also reduces his basic Abilities' Cooldowns by 11% of their Maximum per stack. Active: Varus' next Piercing Arrow deals an additional 6/7/8/9/10% missing Health magic damage, increased up to 10.2/11.9/13.6/15.3/17% missing Health damage based on charge time.

E.name: Hail of Arrows
E.resolvedDescription: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deals 60/90/120/150/180 (+90% bonus AD) physical damage and desecrates the ground for 4 seconds, Slowing enemies by 30/35/40/45/50% and applying 40% Grievous Wounds.

R.name: Chain of Corruption
R.resolvedDescription: Varus flings out a tendril of corruption, Rooting the first champion hit for 2 seconds and dealing 150/250/350 (+100% AP) magic damage. Rooted enemies gain 3 Blight stacks over the duration. The corruption spreads from its target to uninfected enemy champions. If it reaches them, they take the same damage and Root.
